class.name: VAWorld
class.description: The root node of a raytraced acoustic scene. Add exactly one of these to a level, above any geometry, materials, emitters, and sources that should be part of it. This node's position is the world-space origin of its raytracing bounds; rotation and scale are not used.

method.name: export_to_file
method.description: Exports the world's settings, materials, primitives, and emitters to a binary file at the given native OS path. Returns [code]false[/code] on failure.

method.name: get_main_thread_time
method.description: Returns how long, in milliseconds, the most recent update spent on the main thread.

method.name: get_raytracing_time
method.description: Returns how long, in milliseconds, the most recent update spent raytracing.

method.name: get_preparation_time
method.description: Returns how long, in milliseconds, the most recent update spent preparing for raytracing.

method.name: get_analysis_time
method.description: Returns how long, in milliseconds, the most recent update spent analysing raytracing results.

method.name: get_grouped_eax_count
method.description: Returns the number of active grouped EAX reverb zones.

method.name: get_grouped_eax_gain_lf
method.description: Returns the low-frequency reverb gain of the grouped EAX zone at [param index].

method.name: get_grouped_eax_gain_hf
method.description: Returns the high-frequency reverb gain of the grouped EAX zone at [param index].

method.name: get_grouped_eax_decay_time
method.description: Returns the reverb decay time, in seconds, of the grouped EAX zone at [param index].

members.member: The world-space origin of the raytracing bounds. All rays are confined within [member bounds_size] of this position; emitters outside the bounds are not raytraced, and primitives fully outside the bounds don't affect raytracing.

The size of the raytracing bounds, extending from [member position]. All rays are confined within these bounds; emitters outside them are not raytraced, and primitives fully outside them don't affect raytracing.
The color of the bounds gizmo drawn in the editor viewport. Editor-only visualization; has no effect on raytracing.
The epsilon value used for raytracing and primitive intersections.
Whether the entire world is considered indoors or outdoors. When [code]false[/code], reverb rays stop accumulating energy after hitting the world edge.
The maximum number of grouped EAX reverb properties shared across all emitters that affect grouped EAX. Higher values increase accuracy but are more expensive to run.

How many meters one world unit represents. Affects air absorption and reverb. This is separate from [member VAOpenALSettings.meters_per_unit], which only affects OpenAL's own air-absorption and reverb decay math.
The speed of sound, in meters per second. Affects air absorption and reverb. This is separate from [member VAOpenALSettings.speed_of_sound], which only affects OpenAL's own Doppler calculation.
The air humidity percentage, from 0.0 to 1.0. Affects air absorption.
The air temperature, in degrees Celsius. Affects air absorption.
The atmospheric pressure, in Pascals. Affects air absorption.
The low-frequency reference, in Hz. Affects air absorption and reverb.
The high-frequency reference, in Hz. Affects air absorption and reverb.
If [code]true[/code], emitters outside the world bounds have zero occlusion/permeation energy (fully muffled). If [code]false[/code], they have maximum energy (unmuffled).
The maximum number of threads that can run in parallel for this world. Set to 0 to default to the user's processor count minus one.
The number of work items to distribute raytracing work across. A value higher than your thread count helps evenly distribute work across all threads.
When set to [code]true[/code], the world stops submitting new raytracing work to background threads, allowing it to shut down cleanly.

If [code]true[/code], opens a native debug window visualising raytracing (dev build only). Not applied if the project's renderer is gl_compatibility, since the debug window's own native OpenGL context is known to crash the engine in that configuration.
